toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Vergaan' already means to waste away; 'weg' after it is redundant and unidiomatic.
toegepas.fout: 'vergaan ... weg' is redundant; 'vergaan' already carries the sense
toegepas.rede_keurder: Removes a redundant particle; 'gewoonlik' and 'heeltemal' stay, so the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: sedimentêre gesteente en daar is 'n goeie rede daarvoor
toegepas.na: sedimentêre gesteente, en daar is 'n goeie rede daarvoor
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two sentences each with its own subject and verb; the protected wording stays intact.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two main clauses joined by 'en'
toegepas.rede_keurder: Both sides of 'en' have their own subject and verb, and the protected wording stays intact.

toegepas.voor: Presies daardie modder en sand is wat die plant of dier toegemaak het
toegepas.na: Dit was juis daardie modder en sand wat die plant of dier toegemaak het
toegepas.rede_vinder: Calque of 'precisely that ... is what'; the Afrikaans cleft 'Dit was juis ... wat' is natural and the past tense matches the event.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Dit was juis ... wat' is the natural Afrikaans cleft and keeps the same claim.

toegepas.voor: Die laag word later hard en die fossiel sit vas daarin
toegepas.na: Die laag word later hard, en die fossiel sit daarin vas
toegepas.rede_vinder: Separable verb 'vassit' puts 'vas' at the end; AWS comma before 'en' joining two full sentences.
toegepas.fout: separable verb split unnaturally ('sit vas daarin') and missing AWS comma between two main clauses
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'sit daarin vas' is the natural word order and the comma joins two full sentences.

toegepas.voor: uit die kalk uit die doppe en harde dele van seediere
toegepas.na: uit die kalk van seediere se doppe en harde dele
toegepas.rede_vinder: Avoids the clumsy double 'uit ... uit' without changing the meaning.
toegepas.rede_keurder: Same content (lime from sea animals' shells and hard parts) in a smoother construction, and 'meestal' stays intact.

toegepas.blok: Wat die lae vir ons sê
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Dieper onder' is not idiomatic; 'laer af' is the natural way to say lower down in the layers.
toegepas.fout: 'dieper onder' is not the idiomatic form
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'laer af' is the natural way to say lower down in the layers, and the meaning stays the same.

toegepas.voor: Die rotse hou tog 'n rekord van daardie lewe vir ons
toegepas.na: Tog bewaar die rotse vir ons 'n rekord van daardie lewe
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Hou 'n rekord ... vir ons' is a calque of 'keep a record for us'; 'bewaar' with 'vir ons' before the object reads naturally.
toegepas.fout: 'hou 'n rekord ... vir ons' copies English 'keep a record for us'
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'bewaar' is the exact Afrikaans verb here, and 'tog' keeps its contrastive sense at the front.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma before 'en' joining two sentences each with its own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: missing AWS comma between two main clauses joined by 'en'
toegepas.rede_keurder: Each side of 'en' has its own subject and verb ('Fossiele word verdeel', 'albei lê').

toegepas.voor: 'n deel van die plant of dier se lyf
toegepas.na: 'n deel van 'n plant of dier se lyf
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'Die plant of dier' refers back to nothing in this block; 'n' is correct and matches the glossary definition.
toegepas.fout: 'die plant of dier' refers back to nothing in the block
toegepas.rede_keurder: The indefinite article is correct here and makes the study sentence match the protected glossary definition word for word.

laat_vaar.voor: Die modder en sand daar rondom
laat_vaar.na: Die modder en sand rondom dit
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Daar rondom' is loose; 'rondom dit' is the natural, clear form at this grade.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'daar rondom' reads acceptably, while 'dit' could point to either the hard parts or the shape in the previous sentence, so the proposal adds an ambiguous pronoun.

laat_vaar.blok: Wat moet gebeur, en wat die kans beter maak
laat_vaar.voor: Wat moet gebeur, en wat die kans beter maak
laat_vaar.na: Wat moet gebeur en wat die kans beter maak
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: AWS: no comma before 'en' between two parts of one phrase that are not separate sentences (heading; apply only if headings are editable).
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The heading joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb, so the comma is allowed, and it marks the split between what must happen and what helps.

laat_vaar.voor: drie gesteentes wat uit sulke lae kom
laat_vaar.na: drie gesteentes wat in lae vorm
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Uit sulke lae kom' is wooden and vague; the previous sentence already says these rocks form in layers.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'uit sulke lae kom' links back to the previous sentence, and the proposal only repeats 'in lae vorm' from that sentence, which is a lateral move that adds repetition.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Vind' is the usual word for finding fossils; 'kry' is colloquial here.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'kry' meaning 'find' is plain, natural Afrikaans for a Grade 5 reader, so swapping it for 'vind' is lateral.

vlae.teks: 'n Fossiel van 'n teken wat 'n plant of dier agtergelaat het, is 'n spoorfossiel.
vlae.rede: The study-text sentence lacks the closing phrase 'nie van 'n deel van sy lyf nie' that the glossary definition carries and that the protected entry says keeps leaf imprints and root casts with body fossils. Adding it is content, so it is not proposed; a person or the writer should decide whether this sentence should match the decided definition.

vlae.teks: Sandsteen en kalksteen is twee rotse waarin mense fossiele kry.
vlae.rede: The block names three rocks (leiklip, sandsteen, kalksteen) but this closing sentence names only two, which may read as if leiklip carries no fossils. Not changed because it is a content choice.
